content:
To exceed the previous maximum digit sum of 81, the number must have digit sum at least 82.  
The smallest 10-digit number with digit sum 82 is \(1\) followed by nine \(9\)'s:

\[
1999999999
\]

Every smaller number has digit sum at most \(81\), so this satisfies the condition.

\[
\boxed{1999999999}
\]
